sentences.japanese: 明らかに、彼らは彼の富と地位を妬んでいる。
sentences.english: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.

sentences.japanese: 彼女らの妬みは彼女の美しさに向けられた。
sentences.english: Their envy was directed toward her beauty.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は隣の人の幸運を妬んでいた。
sentences.english: She was jealous of her neighbor's good fortune.

sentences.japanese: 彼は彼女の才能に焼もちを妬いている。
sentences.english: He is jealous of her talent.

sentences.japanese: 彼は彼らの幸せを妬んでいた。
sentences.english: He was jealous of their happiness.
